source: INEGI, Censo de Poblacion y Vivienda 2020, ITER

variables.label: Covered by IMSS
variables.description: Share of people affiliated with IMSS, the social security institute that mainly covers formal private-sector workers and their families (a proxy for the formal economy)

variables.label: Homes with a car
variables.description: Share of occupied homes with a car or pickup truck

variables.label: Homes with a computer
variables.description: Share of occupied homes with a computer, laptop, or tablet

variables.label: Adults with high school or more
variables.description: Share of people aged 18+ whose schooling reaches at least some high school, teacher training, technical school, or beyond

variables.label: Indigenous-language speakers
variables.description: Share of people aged 3+ who speak an Indigenous language

variables.label: Afro-Mexican
variables.description: Share of people who consider themselves Afro-Mexican or Afro-descendant

variables.label: Aged 65 and over
variables.description: Share of people aged 65 or older

variables.label: No health coverage
variables.description: Share of people not affiliated with any public or private health service

variables.label: Living with a disability
variables.description: Share of people with a lot of difficulty, or unable, to see, hear, walk, remember, care for themselves, or communicate

variables.label: Cannot read or write
variables.description: Share of people aged 15+ who cannot read and write a short note

variables.label: Average years of schooling
variables.description: Average grades completed by people aged 15+ (INEGI excludes those who did not state them)

variables.label: Homes with internet
variables.description: Share of occupied homes with internet access

variables.label: Homes without electricity
variables.description: Share of occupied homes without electric power

variables.label: Homes without any communication technology
variables.description: Share of occupied homes with no radio, TV, computer, phone line, cell phone, or internet
